issues.description: The abstract animal feeding method is named inconsistently across the exercise materials. The UML and several task descriptions in the problem statement specify an abstract method named messageOnFeed(), while other places in the problem text (the per-animal tasks) refer to getFeedingSound(). The reference solution and its Farm usage implement and call messageOnFeed(), so the stray references to getFeedingSound() in the problem statement will mislead students about which method to implement and call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Prefer keeping messageOnFeed() (matches the UML and the solution). Update problem_statement.md to replace all occurrences of getFeedingSound() with messageOnFeed(), and ensure the template text and examples reference messageOnFeed() as the method to implement and call. Alternatively, if you prefer getFeedingSound(), change the UML, template, and solution to use getFeedingSound() everywhere — but do not leave both names in the exercise materials.
